dwelling_habits.dwelling: Buried in sand flats — often only eyes and spiracles show.
dwelling_habits.food: Worms, crabs, and clams found by electro-sense.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Flips sand with wingbeats, then vacuums hidden snacks.
dwelling_habits.mating: Live-bearing; nursery flats can hold many young rays.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Mostly solitary couch potatoes of the seafloor.

fun_facts: Shuffle your feet in sand — a polite knock so rays can scoot away.
The barb is defense, not a hunting spear.
